jobs.title: Part-Time Security Officer — Flexible Shifts & Growth
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Part Time Security Officer in Joliet, IL to monitor and protect client sites, deliver customer service, and maintain a visible, reassuring presence.

You will work a set schedule with day and evening shifts, earning $16.21 per hour, and participate in a supportive team that values reliability, teamwork, and integrity.

This role requires at least a high school diploma, ability to pass background checks and drug screens, and adherence to state licensing where required.

jobs.title: Per Diem Night Hospital Security Officer
jobs.description:
Montefiore Nyack Hospital in Nyack, NY is seeking a Security Officer to patrol the premises, monitor surveillance, and coordinate with other departments to prevent losses and damages. Works with minimal supervision and supports hospital operations during night shifts and weekends.

Requirements include a High School Diploma, 1-3 years hospital security experience, CPR and First Aid, and the NY Department of State Security Guard license. Per diem, part-time and full-time options available.

jobs.title: Flexible Part-Time Security Officer – Earn More Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Observation in Joliet, IL. This role offers reliable, fixed shifts with the option to pick up extra shifts to increase earnings, within a supportive, security-focused team.

The position pays $16.21 per hour with a day-time schedule and a six-month anchor shift commitment. Applicants may work additional shifts via the scheduling platform for up to 40 hours per week.
